name: Amazon

rounds.name: Online Assessment 1
rounds.detail: 2 coding problems (medium/hard) + debugging section + workstyle survey.

rounds.name: Online Assessment 2
rounds.detail: Work simulation + logic reasoning, aligned to leadership principles.

rounds.name: Technical Round 1
rounds.detail: DSA (arrays, strings, graphs, DP) with complexity analysis; no IDE, shared doc.

rounds.name: Technical Round 2 + Bar Raiser
rounds.detail: Advanced DSA, low-level design and Leadership-Principle behavioural questions.

aptitudePatterns.sample: Given a log of failed orders, what sequence of actions best follows the customer-obsession principle?
State the time and space complexity of your solution and prove why it cannot be improved.

codingPatterns.sample: Container with most water - return the maximum area.
Minimum number of steps to transform one word into another (word ladder).
Longest palindromic substring / maximum sum subarray variants.
Merge k sorted lists and k most frequent elements.

hrQuestions: Tell me about a time you took ownership of a failure. (Ownership)
Describe a situation where you disagreed with a mentor and how you handled it. (Have Backbone)
Give an example of delivering results under a hard deadline. (Deliver Results)
tips: Every behavioural answer must be a STAR story - prepare 8 stories covering the leadership principles.
Talk through your approach before coding; interviewers score communication.
Practise on a plain text editor, not an IDE with autocomplete.
